Anchors.description: Each alternative has its own anchors.

AnyText.description: [\s\S]* is any text, line breaks included.

Quoted.description: Text a template literal would read is written as a string.

Dot.description: A dot does not match line breaks, which no type leaves out.

Repeated.description: Any number of a class is no template.

TooMany.description: TypeScript builds no union of 100,000 strings.

Unreadable.description: A pattern JavaScript cannot read leaves the string as it is.

Listed.description: The values enum lists that the pattern admits.

MemberValues.description: Another member's values that the pattern admits.

Member.description: A member's pattern applies to the strings type says.

Typeless.description: Without type, values of the other kinds pass the pattern.

Nothing.description: maxLength: 0 admits the empty string, which the pattern does not.
